name: Call of Air
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.

The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.

Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.
narrative.objectives: Find Veyric Thundervein in Arathi Highlands.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 30 to 40, 17,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Call of Air
quests.objectiveText: Find Veyric Thundervein in Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Elemental Aid
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.

quests.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
quests.objectiveText: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Heed My Call
quests.objectiveText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

quests.name: The Tempest's Weapons
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
